verdict.rationale: Datadog exposes a full REST/API reference, an official CLI (datadog-ci), and an MCP server, all of which could be used to script bulk actions (e.g., bulk monitor creation, bulk tagging) across many items, but no evidence describes an explicit bulk-operations feature, batch endpoints, or AI-native bulk workflows in the docs pack. missing for 10: explicit documentation of bulk/batch API endpoints or UI bulk-actions, evidence of AI-native agents performing multi-item operations via MCP/CLI, and any hands-on confirmation of bulk workflows.
